# StackBuild

> Construction payroll, timesheet, and safety certification management platform for construction companies.

StackBuild streamlines construction business operations with payroll, invoicing, certificate tracking, project and jobsite control, material requests, and multi-role access for admins, foremen, and workers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Plans, pricing, and overview of StackBuild's construction management platform.
- [Start Trial](/start-trial): Begin a trial of StackBuild.
- [Admin Login](/admin-login): Sign in for company admins, managers, and foremen.
- [Employee Login](/employee-login): Sign in for construction workers and employees.
- [Company Registration](/company-registration): Complete company onboarding after subscription.
